businessInfo.name: 游玩起来看起来就像个

subject: Fix movement: walking must work with gravity and step-up
description: Walking/gravity is broken so the player can only move by flying. Diagnose with live instrumentation on http://127.0.0.1:5174/?preview via __mc.player: check onGround, vel.y, solid[] flags, sub-stepping/tunneling, step-up height, and whether update() is gated off. Deliver vanilla-like ground movement: gravity, jump, step-up 0.6, no tunneling, sprint, and correct keyboard+touch input.
